fieldMapping.note: Linear issue ID maps to Discord channel identifier
All comments concatenated into a single digest string

assumptions: The Linear webhook payload includes a cursor field for pagination and an array of comment objects with author and body text.
A Discord webhook URL or bot token with channel permissions is available to post the message.
The integration will aggregate all paginated comments into one message rather than posting individually per page.

sources.title: Now – Updates from the Linear team

notes: The webhook payload includes 'action', 'type', 'data' (containing issue details), and optionally 'cursor' and 'comments' for pagination.
To fetch all comments, the connector must use Linear's GraphQL API with cursor-based pagination, as the webhook may only include a subset.
Verify the request using the 'Linear-Signature' header and the secret stored in LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
Ensure the endpoint returns HTTP 200 to avoid retries.
The 'Linear-Event' header will be 'Issue' for issue.closed events.

example.content:
Linear issue closed

Comments:
- Alice: First comment
- Bob: Second comment

responseExample.content:
Linear issue closed

Comments:
- Alice: First comment
- Bob: Second comment

notes: The URL must be constructed from the Discord webhook's ID and token, typically stored as a single environment variable DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL in the format https://discord.com/api/webhooks/{id}/{token}.
The 'content' field is required and limited to 2000 characters.
No authentication headers are needed when using the webhook URL with token.
If the message includes embeds, files, or other components, adjust the payload accordingly, but for a simple digest, content suffices.
Discord may strip invalid Unicode; ensure the digest is plain text.
